options.content:
# **Arc - SQL Server Inventory**

This dashboard provides insights into the entire SQL Server estate enabled by Azure Arc.

panels.description: Count of SQL DB Engine

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')

| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances" and properties.serviceType == "Engine"
| summarize ["SQL DB Engine Servers"]=count()

panels.title: SQL DB Engine

azureResourceGraph.query:

| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')

| where type in~ ("microsoft.sql/managedinstances/databases","microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases","microsoft.sql/servers/databases")
| where name !in~ ("master","model","msdb","tempdb")
| summarize ["Total User DB Count"] = count()

panels.title: SQL Server Databases

panels.description: Standard or Enterprise Edition vs other SQL Server Editions

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')

    | where type == 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
    | extend version = tostring(properties.version)
    | extend edition = properties.edition
    | extend containerId = tolower(tostring (properties.containerResourceId))
    //add clause back in for live dashboard
    | extend serverClass = iff(edition in ("Enterprise", "Standard"), "Ent/Std", "Express/Dev etc") 
| summarize count() by serverClass

panels.title: SQL Server Edition Type

panels.description: Count of SQL Engine instances by version

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')

| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances" and properties.serviceType == "Engine"
| extend version = tostring(properties["version"])
| summarize Count = count() by version
| order by version asc

panels.title: SQL Server database Compatibility Level

panels.description: Count of SQL Server servers by extension license type

| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')

| where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions" 
| where properties.type in ("WindowsAgent.SqlServer","LinuxAgent.SqlServer")
| summarize count() by tostring(properties.settings.LicenseType)

panels.title: Extension License Type

panels.description: Count of SQL Server servers by Defender protection status

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')

| where  type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
| summarize Count=count() by iff(tostring(properties['azureDefenderStatus'])=="Unknown", "Not Protected",tostring(properties['azureDefenderStatus']))
| order by Count desc

panels.title: Defender for SQL Server

panels.description: Count of databases encrypted and not encrypted

azureResourceGraph.query:

| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')

| where ['type']  =="microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases"
| summarize Count=count() by Encrypte=iif(tostring(properties['databaseOptions'].isEncrypted)=="false","No", "Yes")

panels.title: Encrypted Databases

panels.description: Number of cores per SQL Server instance

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')
 | where type =~ "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances" | where properties.serviceType =~ "Engine" | project SqlServerName = name, SQLEdition = tostring(properties.edition), LicenseType = tostring(properties.licenseType), CPUCores = toint(properties.vCore) | order by CPUCores desc

panels.title: Cores per SQL Server Instance

panels.description: Count of SQL Server instances by **instances** license type and edition

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')

| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances" and properties.serviceType == "Engine"
| extend d = parse_json(properties)
| extend Patch = d["patchLevel"]
| extend SQLVersion = d["version"]
| extend Edition = d["edition"]
| extend License = d["licenseType"]
| project name, Patch, SQLVersion, Edition, License
| summarize Count = count() by tostring(License), tostring(Edition)

panels.title: SQL Server Edition Summary

panels.description: Number of DBs and size per SQL Server instance

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')

| where  type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases"
| summarize Dbs=count(),Offline=sum(toint(iif(tostring(properties["state"])!="Online",1,0)))
,SizeMB=sum(toint(iif(tostring(properties["sizeMB"])!="",properties["sizeMB"],0))) by Instances = tostring(split(tostring(id),"/")[8])
| order by SizeMB desc 
| take 20

panels.title: DB Details per SQL Server Instance

panels.description: Details of SQL Server DBs

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')
 | where type == 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases' | project name, Instances = tostring(split(tostring(id), '/')[8]), SizeMB = round(toint(properties['sizeMB']),0), SpaceAvailableMB = round(toint(properties['spaceAvailableMB']),0), State = properties['state'],  CreationDate = properties['databaseCreationDate'], CollationName = properties['collationName'], RecoveryMode = properties['recoveryMode'], CompatibilityLevel = properties['compatibilityLevel'] | order by toint(SizeMB) desc

panels.title: Databases Details

options.content:
# **SQL Server Instances by Tag Values**

Shows SQL Server instance distribution by various tag values.

panels.description: SQL Servers instances by "Application" tag values

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where '${sub:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${sub:raw},' contains strcat(',', subscriptionId, ',')
| where '${rg:raw}' == '__all__' or ',${rg:raw},' contains strcat(',', resourceGroup, ',')

| where  ['type']  == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
//Tag values - edit here for custom tags
| extend application = tostring(tags.Application)
| summarize ServerCount = count() by application

panels.title: SQL Server Instances by Application
